source_title: ICU Admission, Discharge, and Triage Guidelines
clinical_context: Use for WardCoordinator sorting prompts when ICU-level monitoring or intervention may be needed.
key_points: The guideline suggests guiding ICU admissions by prioritization models, diagnosis, objective parameters, potential to benefit, and prognosis.
Prioritization supports human review and resource coordination; it must not decide admission automatically.
resource_context: Supports prioritization prompts when ICU demand exceeds immediate capacity.
fairness_or_ethics_note: Use explicit criteria and human oversight; avoid automated denial or admission decisions.
